requirement: Training labels must use CONFIRMED_PRESENCE or SURVEY_NONDETECTION only when frame rules hold
Presence-only sources must not supply absence labels
SURVEY_NONDETECTION requires completed effort and taxon-in-frame
notes: No effort means UNKNOWN not zero

requirement: Do not pool incompatible protocols without an explicit bridge
SST and other env fields are covariates ENVIRONMENTAL_CONDITION not fish observations
notes: SST is not a fish observation

requirement: Every training row must set explicit time_precision SECOND through UNKNOWN
Covariates must respect as-of published_at_utc cutoff
Likelihood unit is protocol sample support not arbitrary query radius
notes: 50-mile windows are display unless design says otherwise

requirement: Native coordinates stay out of public globe outputs
notes: No raw lat/lon on globe products

requirement: INTERNAL_MODEL_OUTPUT must not be labeled PUBLISHED_NOWCAST or PUBLISHED_FORECAST
notes: Internal models are not published nowcasts

requirement: Model and globe products must set fishing_guidance false
Do not invent numeric minimum n for training or publication
notes: Power analysis required before any n threshold

requirement: Training requires APPROVED_* rights for intended use
notes: Public landing pages are not training permission

requirement: Each model names exactly one prediction target
notes: Do not collapse targets into where-the-fish-are
